Gagnån at the north/start area prohibits tenting and fires. Södra Kroksjön and Hornsjön are the core shelter/rest facilities; second split Furusjö-Mullsjö has no shelter/dry toilet according to Smålandsleden.

fireRules: Use designated fireplaces only and extinguish properly according to whole-trail guidance.
Gagnån nature reserve prohibits fires regardless of regional fire-ban status.
Ryfors gammelskog prohibits fires, but it is continuation/detour context and should not be attached to the stage unless geometry overlap is verified.
Stråkens strandskogar allows fires only at designated places with brought firewood; it is near Mullsjö/continuation context and needs geometry overlay before attaching to stage 8.
